_comment: Single source of truth for external art. Key = the art key used by the game's art maps (ART_IMG, FAC_IMG, ...) or declared by a layer (hq_* from 90-hq-stages.js). Value = filename, resolved against art/ first and the repo root second. Add an entry only after the asset has passed prompt review. 85-art-override.js reads this file at boot and reports coverage to the console.

held.brownstone: Legible street signage, pedestrians and a taxi. Text and people are both excluded.
held.ski: Translucent inset border roughly 3% in from each edge. Borders are excluded.
held.studio: Isometric dollhouse cutaway on a flat dark background. Flat backgrounds are excluded.
held.compound: Helipad marked with the letter H. Lettering is excluded. Arguably a pictogram; awaiting a call.
held.pickup: Translucent vertical bands overlaying the left and right edges, same artifact class as ski.
held.hq_1: Isometric cutaway office floor on a flat green/blue background. Same failure mode as studio. File is in art/ and ships the moment this line moves up to assets.
